_comment: Reviewed exceptions for scripts/auditGate.mjs. Each entry acknowledges a KNOWN high/critical advisory that cannot be fixed without a major/coordinated dependency bump (npm audit fix is a no-op — the fixes fall outside our declared semver ranges and/or are pinned by socket.io). Every entry has an EXPIRY: past it, the gate treats the advisory as a fresh offender so this debt is revisited, not buried. A brand-new advisory not listed here fails CI immediately. TODO: land a dedicated deps-hardening PR (major bumps of multer, ws/socket.io, mysql2) and delete these entries.

1121089.reason: DoS via deeply nested field names; requires major multer bump. Intake uploads are auth-gated + size-capped. Tracked for deps PR.

1193790.reason: DoS via crafted multipart field names; same major-bump requirement as 1121089.

1193793.reason: DoS via oversized array index in field names; same major-bump requirement as 1121089.

1123259.reason: Memory-exhaustion DoS; ws is pinned transitively by socket.io. Requires coordinated socket.io major bump. Tracked for deps PR.

1130713.reason: Zero-attachment memory exhaustion; fixed by the same socket.io major bump as ws. Tracked for deps PR.

1153173.reason: Auth-plugin downgrade could leak credentials to a MALICIOUS MySQL server; mirror-server connects only to a trusted localhost MySQL, so not exploitable in this deployment. Bump mysql2 in the deps PR regardless.
